title: Iran conflict events vs AAL returns (short)
hypothesis: R2 | [fuel-airspace-losers] Iran-Gulf dyad event count 20d z-score > 1.5 hits US network carriers with Gulf-route exposure (-); trade short AAL 3d at 1d lag [gdelt.irn.conflict_events -> finance.AAL.log_return]
message: Weak: r=-0.09 (n=390), heuristic validity 0; short-AAL rule 62 trades sharpe 0.06 in-sample, OOS 21 trades 71% hit / +0.73% avg; actionability 6.0

trade_idea.entry_rule: gdelt.irn.conflict_events rolling_zscore_20d > 1 at close -> short AAL next session
trade_idea.exit_rule: close after 1 trading days (no overlapping entries)
trade_idea.caveats: Backtest on daily closes, no costs/slippage; few independent regimes; signal and target may share the war as common cause.
